summary: EXPRESSbakēd wizard 45/55 map-shell verified on desktop (1440×900) and mobile (390×844). Steps 1–5 all wrap in ExpressWizardShell with a persistent live Google Map on the right (desktop ~55%, left panel ~45%) and a compact 160px map card above the form on mobile. Global module nav still shows only ONE module bar with EXPRESSbakēd highlighted (no duplicate/regressed nav). A/B AdvancedMarkers render on the map after seeding pickup+drop draft in sessionStorage. Vehicle Step 3 renders 5 branded vehicle cards (bike, scooter, three_wheeler, mini_truck, truck) with 80×64 image containers using vehicleImage(code), BEST badge on the cheapest (bike @ 2 654 CFA), and clicking a card immediately updates the map top-left overlay with a vehicle chip containing the branded PNG + code label ('bike'). Step 4 preserves the 45/55 split with 6 package-type chips, 4 weight tiers, 3 dimension inputs, notes textarea. Step 5 renders selected-vehicle mini-card (branded Bike PNG), Price Breakdown (2 654 CFA total), Insurance banner, promo input, COD card, wallet card, and a persistent map on the right showing the BIKE chip. Mobile Step 3 confirms compact map above vehicle cards (map top=127px h=160px w=358px vs. first card top=355px). Admin /admin/modules/express/pricing route still redirects unauthenticated users to the admin login (guard unchanged). No blocking errors from ExpressWizardShell/WizardMap. Google Maps Directions API returns REQUEST_DENIED (legacy Directions API not enabled on this project key) — polyline does not render, but per agent-to-agent context note this is acceptable; A/B markers, vehicle chip and layout all work.

action_items: SPEC GAP (medium priority): vehicleImage(code) in /app/frontend/src/lib/expressAssets.js only exposes 3 distinct PNGs — scooter falls back to bike.png and mini_truck falls back to truck.png. The review request explicitly required all 5 vehicles (bike, scooter, three_wheeler, mini_truck, truck) to have distinct branded PNGs. Either (a) source dedicated scooter + mini-truck renders and add EXPRESS_ASSETS.scooter + EXPRESS_ASSETS.miniTruck, or (b) update the spec to acknowledge the current 3-asset fallback strategy documented in the JSDoc comment.

MAPS API (low/med): Enable legacy Directions API on the Google Maps project OR migrate RoutePolyline in /app/frontend/src/components/express/ExpressWizardShell.jsx to google.maps.routes.Route.computeRoutes so the polyline + distance/duration overlay chips actually render on Steps 2–5. Today they never appear because every DirectionsService.route() call returns REQUEST_DENIED.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpressWizardShell.jsx: WizardMap re-mounts on every step navigation (each step wraps a NEW <ExpressWizardShell> around its content). Because <APIProvider> + <Map> are children of that shell, they get remounted on every step change too. Google Maps JS API is idempotent enough to survive this, but you lose the map camera state (pan/zoom the user did on Step 2 is reset on Step 3). Consider lifting the WizardMap up to a parent route element or ExpressWizardLayout wrapper so it truly persists across steps, matching the ride-share UX intent in the spec.

ExpressWizardShell.jsx L82-96: FitBounds effect runs on every draft change and calls map.fitBounds() unconditionally — combined with the RoutePolyline's DirectionsRenderer having preserveViewport:false, the fit happens twice on route-success. Fine functionally, but visually the map jumps. Consider preserveViewport:true on the DirectionsRenderer so FitBounds is the single source of truth for the camera.

ExpressWizardShell.jsx L52: The RoutePolyline useEffect depends on `onMeta` (a setState function from parent). Since the parent passes a fresh inline function via setMeta each render, this effect re-runs every render and creates a new DirectionsService + DirectionsRenderer each time. This is the reason we see 4+ REQUEST_DENIED errors per step load. Fix by wrapping onMeta in useCallback in the parent OR removing onMeta from the dep array (route only depends on pickup/drop).

expressAssets.js: vehicleImage() only has 3 distinct renders (bike, threeW, truck). scooter→bike and mini_truck→truck. The doc-comment 'Fallback to truck for larger types until dedicated renders are supplied' openly admits the gap. This contradicts the review-request statement that all 5 must be distinct. Explicit action: add dedicated scooter + miniTruck assets or update the spec.
ExpressWizard.jsx L3: Bike, Truck lucide-react icons are still imported but no longer used since Step 3 switched to . Dead imports — minor lint noise.

ExpressWizardShell.jsx WizardMap: no error-boundary / fallback if APIProvider fails to load the JS SDK. If the network drops or the key becomes invalid, the map div stays empty with no visible message on Steps 2–5. Consider a onError handler on APIProvider or a timeout + fallback text.

ExpressWizardShell.jsx L204: The desktop sticky container uses `h-[calc(100vh-140px)]`. On very short viewports (<=700px height on desktop, e.g. laptops) that may compute to less than the map's inner min-h-[520px], causing the outer container to be shorter than the map and possible overflow. Consider min-h-[420px] or a responsive value.

ExpressStepEstimate.jsx L338: `useEffect(() => { fetchQuote(); }, [draft.pickup, draft.drop, draft.vehicle_code])` — draft.pickup and draft.drop are objects so referential equality is not stable across sessionStorage rehydrations. React may refetch on every re-render. Consider depending on primitive latitude/longitude or memoising.

rca_of_the_issue: No production bug caused this run to fail. Two observations worth main-agent action: (1) Directions REQUEST_DENIED — root cause is Google Maps project doesn't have legacy Directions API enabled + the RoutePolyline effect has an unstable onMeta dep causing 4+ retries per step; (2) Vehicle assets not distinct — expressAssets.js explicitly falls back scooter→bike PNG and mini_truck→truck PNG, contradicting the spec requirement.
